segments.source: Maya is a parent of Noah. Noah is a parent of Lina. Maya is also a parent of Owen. Owen is a parent of Sara. Cross-domain check: a survey team starts work at 8:00 and works for 2 hour(s) without a break.

A parent is one generation above a child. A grandparent is two parent-links above. People who share a parent are siblings under this simplified model. For the cross-domain check, finishing time = starting time + duration.
What family relation between Noah and Owen follows from the stated links? Cross-domain check: at what time does the team finish?
1. Maya is parent of both Noah and Owen. 2. Sharing a parent satisfies the simplified sibling rule. Cross-domain check: 8+2=10, so the team finishes at 10:00.
Noah and Owen are siblings. Cross-domain answer: 10:00.

Maya is a parent of Noah. Noah is a parent of Lina. Maya is also a parent of Owen. Owen is a parent of Sara. Cross-domain check: a local committee has 10 members, requires at least 6 present for quorum, and 8 are present.

A parent is one generation above a child. A grandparent is two parent-links above. People who share a parent are siblings under this simplified model. For the cross-domain check, quorum exists when present members ≥ the stated threshold.
What family relation between Maya and Sara follows from the stated links? Cross-domain check: is quorum met?
1. Maya→Owen and Owen→Sara form two parent links. Cross-domain check: compare 8 with 6; 8≥6 is true.
Maya is a grandparent of Sara. Cross-domain answer: quorum is met.

Maya is a parent of Noah. Noah is a parent of Lina. Maya is also a parent of Owen. Owen is a parent of Sara. Cross-domain check: researchers collected 11 reports, but 4 are exact duplicate copies that add no new independent information.

A parent is one generation above a child. A grandparent is two parent-links above. People who share a parent are siblings under this simplified model. For the cross-domain check, independent reports = total reports − duplicate copies.
What family relation between Lina and Sara follows from the stated links? Cross-domain check: how many non-duplicate reports remain?

1. Noah and Owen are siblings because they share parent Maya. 2. Lina is child of Noah; Sara is child of Owen. 3. Children of siblings are cousins in this model. Cross-domain check: 11−4=7 independent reports remain.
Lina and Sara are cousins under the implied family tree. Cross-domain answer: 7 independent reports.

Problem 436. Temporal compatibility in a story set in 1400
Anachronism can be tested as a compatibility problem when the relevant date ranges are supplied.

For this problem, availability intervals are: Technology A: 1200–1600; Institution B: 1500–1900; Tool C: 1700–2000; Practice D: 1300–1450. A story is set in 1400 and mentions Technology A and Tool C together. Cross-domain check: on a field sketch, 1 cm represents 3 km and two checkpoints are 4 cm apart.

An item is temporally compatible with a year only if the year lies inside its stated availability interval. An anachronism is an item placed outside its given interval. For the cross-domain check, real distance = sketch distance × kilometres per centimetre.
